key_findings.finding: The reaction search did not return an exact record for the specified iodoquinoline (`Ic1ccc2ncccc2c1`) in DMF. It returned closely related Suzuki records using the corresponding bromoquinoline (`Brc1ccc2ncccc2c1`) with the exact boronic acid partner. Therefore, the yields are precedent estimates rather than an exact-match prediction.

source_tools.relevance: Search output identifies the bromo substrate, while the query used the iodo substrate; all records list solvent `CO`, not DMF.

key_findings.finding: For potassium hydroxide specifically, triphenylphosphine had the closest direct precedent: candidate SMILES `c1ccc(cc1)P(c2ccccc2)c3ccccc3` with palladium acetate and `[OH-].[K+]`, giving 76.3% yield at 100 °C for 5 h. This is the best-supported ligand choice for the stated KOH condition.

source_tools.relevance: Record 4 directly reports PPh3, Pd(OAc)2, KOH, 76.3% yield, 100 °C, 5 h.

key_findings.finding: A second phosphine precedent was tricyclohexylphosphine, exact candidate SMILES `C1CCC(CC1)P(C2CCCCC2)C3CCCCC3`, but it was reported with cesium carbonate rather than KOH and gave 78.1% yield. Its higher yield is not a controlled comparison to the PPh3/KOH result.
